title: Prospective Gaia DR3 wide-binary compatibility test

interpretation.claim: Tests whether a frozen phenomenological external-field comparator and Newtonian gravity are compatible with a Gaia DR3 wide-binary acceleration residual under the declared selection, deprojection, multiplicity, and uncertainty treatment.
not_claimed: blind discovery of the Gaia wide-binary anomaly
independence from Chae's published scientific result
proof of modified gravity or rejection of every Newtonian systematic model
interpretation.prior_exposure: Chae's published anomaly and approximate reported effect sizes were known before this contract. No observational Gaia outcome has been computed by the repository qualification implementation.

selection.component_distance_match: within three combined standard deviations plus the published orbital allowance

population.exclusions: Every row satisfying the frozen selection is analyzed. No row, acceleration bin, Monte Carlo realization, or multiplicity scenario may be removed after an observational residual is computed.

analysis.deprojection: Use the qualified deterministic implementation of isotropic inclination, the published eccentricity uncertainty, uniform mean anomaly, and Kepler-equation orbital phase.
analysis.newtonian_control: Generate controls locally from the same frozen population, mass model, nuisance scenario, and deterministic sampling streams. The published virtual Newtonian CSV is prohibited.
analysis.mass_magnitude_relation: Use the pinned revised-script mass-magnitude tables with ML_choice v and the published interpolation and extinction corrections.
analysis.proper_motion_uncertainty: Perturb both components using their catalogued uncertainties in every Monte Carlo realization.
analysis.radial_velocity: Use the published 3 km/s radial-velocity uncertainty treatment where applicable; do not impose a post-outcome radial-velocity cut.

unresolved_multiplicity.treatment: Reproduce the pinned revised source's higher-order multiplicity assignment and hidden-companion orbital model using deterministic generators.
unresolved_multiplicity.decision_rule: Only the 0.5 result determines confirmatory outcomes. Sensitivity scenarios are reported in full and cannot replace the primary after outcomes are known.

sampling.resampling: For each realization, sample selected binary rows with replacement, then use paired row indices and paired nuisance streams for observation and Newtonian control.
sampling.interval: The closed 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the 2048 paired realization statistics.

analysis.primary_statistic: In the low bin, the median observed orthogonal residual minus the median locally generated Newtonian-control orthogonal residual, evaluated per paired realization.
secondary_statistics: The identically constructed paired residual in the mid bin.
The identically constructed paired residual in the high-control bin.
All three residuals under multiplicity fractions 0.3 and 0.7.

comparators.classification: phenomenological comparator, not a first-principles EMRF prediction

hypotheses.criterion: Compatible only if 0.1278055783326812 dex lies inside the closed primary 95 percent interval. Otherwise this declared phenomenological comparator is rejected.
Newtonian compatibility is rejected only if 0 dex lies outside the closed primary 95 percent interval; otherwise it is retained.
Compatible only if 0.012656679930213948 dex lies inside the closed mid-bin 95 percent interval. It cannot override H1.

numerical_gate.convergence_check: Compare statistics from the first 1024 realizations with all 2048 realizations.
numerical_gate.failure_rule: Any missing selected row, empty or undersized bin, non-finite value, failed control, failed convergence threshold, or incomplete multiplicity scenario makes the confirmatory result incomplete. Partial outcomes must not be classified as accepted or rejected.

required: exact input, qualification, preregistration, and commitment hashes
complete selection counts and selected identifier hash
all 2048 primary and secondary realization statistics
criterion result for every registered hypothesis
forbidden: computing an observational outcome before this contract is committed and merged to protected main
changing cuts, bins, seeds, ensemble size, nuisance fractions, comparators, or thresholds after viewing outcomes
using the published virtual Newtonian CSV
silently excluding failed rows or realizations
selecting a sensitivity scenario as primary after viewing outcomes
describing the phenomenological comparator as a derived first-principles EMRF prediction
describing a known published anomaly as a blind discovery
claiming that agreement proves EMRF or that disagreement establishes Newtonian gravity
